label: Placeholder Overlay
description: Kanban board with a drop outline. Best for task cards with priority, assignee and due date, dragged by a grip with the card or column they will land on outlined.

label: Dynamic Overlay
description: Kanban board with movable columns. Best for task columns dragged by the grip in their header, the column following the finger while the cards move too.

label: Frame Columns
description: Kanban board with status columns. Best for columns with a status icon and count over Frame label cards, where only the cards drag.

label: Stacked Frame
description: Minimal kanban with stacked frame. Best for stacked Frame columns with a one line description each, over cards with a progress bar and assignee.

label: Feature Roadmap
description: Feature roadmap kanban with progress. Best for a product roadmap of feature cards with description, progress bar and vote count across color coded stages.

label: Persisted Moves
description: Kanban board persisted to a backend. Best for drops saved to a simulated API, with a promise toast and a rollback to the previous board on failure.
